RECOGNITION OF EMPLOYEES PROVIDENT FUND IN THE CASE OF ONLINE CLASSIFIEDS PAKISTAN (SMCPRIVATE) LIMITED EMPLOYEES PROVIDENT FUND, NTN- A022392:
ONLINE CLASSIFIEDS PAKISTAN (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED EMPLOYEES PROVIDENT FUND, NTN- A022392
applied for recognition as Provident Fund under Clause-I of Part-I of 6th Schedule to the Income Tax
Ordinance, 2001 through Iris.
In order to verify the application of the applicant in terms of clause-I of Part-I of 6th Schedule to the
Income Tax Ordinance, 2001, a committee consisting of departmental officers was constituted. After
scrutiny of the record submitted by the applicant, the Committee submitted its report vide letter bearing
No. 40 dated 05.04.2022 and has proposed that the applicant qualifies for recognition as Provident Fund.
In exercise of powers conferred under Clause-I of Part-I of 6th Schedule to the Income Tax Ordinance,
2001, I the Commissioner Inland Revenue, Legal, Corporate Tax Office, Lahore do hereby accord
recognition to the Employees Provident Fund ONLINE CLASSIFIEDS PAKISTAN (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED
EMPLOYEES PROVIDENT FUND, NTN- A022392 instituted by the said concern. This recognition shall
remain effective subject to the conditions specified in Clause (2) of Part-I of the 6th Schedule to the
Income Tax Ordinance, 2001.
This certificate is issued subject to the following conditions:1.
A notice may be served on the trustees of the fund as prescribed under Rule 10 of the Sixth
Schedule by the Commissioner requiring them to file returns of income within 30 days from the receipt
of recognition.
2.
Trustees shall also file following documents within 30 days from the end of every accounting
period.
i.
Bank statement in respect of fund for the relevant period
ii.
Detail of any further investment
iii.
Audited accounts
iv.
Details of withdrawals during the period and its utilization within 30 days from the end of each tax
year.
v.
Abstract for the fund’s accounting period of individual account as per Rule 95 of the Income Tax
Rules 2001
In case of non submission of above mentioned documents within prescribed time limit, the Recognition
of the Fund will stand withdrawn from the its recognition.

Humaira Maryam
Commissioner (Legal)
Inland Revenue,
CTO LAHORE, NABHA ROAD
LAHORE
